Nozomi's Innovation and Development Justify Support and Licensing Renewals
Nozomi is a breath of fresh air in a stagnating space. They're collaborative with the customer and focus on providing solutions that fit a customer's needs instead of trying to shape the customer to fit their products. Their support team goes above and beyond and is clearly motivated by resolutions instead of just counting case closure KPIs.
